description:
Get webhook delivery statistics including total deliveries, success/failure counts, and recent activity.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_webhook_stats

delivery_rate.description: Delivered share of all deliveries, a percentage with one decimal and a `%` sign; `0%` when there are none

recent_failures_24h.description: Failed deliveries last updated in the past 24 hours
